_note: CRITERION A4 -- the window bound, tested rather than trusted.
The periodic window is W(k) = window_c * ceil(sqrt k) and the claim is that
its wrap error is at most 2 exp(-window_c^2/8) ~ 1.5e-8 at the default 12 --
small enough that the walker never feels the boundary and the SSEP's
correlations never come round the back. A bound is worth what its test is
worth, so this pair runs the SAME p, ladder, budget and seed at window_c 12
and 24, and A4 passes when gamma_hat moves by less than one standard error.
window_c = 24 costs exactly twice the wall clock for the same stated budget:
